nodes.label: GameState TypedDict
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for LangGraph shared state (schemas/); TypedDict with Annotated operator.add reducers so skills/inventory/relationships/tool_results accumulate across nodes.

nodes.label: GameState character_stats field
nodes.rationale: Optional CharacterStats snapshot carried in state so mechanics/summarizer/story nodes share one canonical stat block.

nodes.label: GameState inventory field
nodes.rationale: Reducing list (operator.add) of InventoryItem so parallel mechanics can append loot deterministically.

nodes.label: GameState grid_data field
nodes.rationale: Dict of GridCell lists holding the 15x15 encounter/world view shared between image/worldgen nodes and story.

nodes.label: GameState rolling memory (context/chat_log)
nodes.rationale: Rolling context string capped at 8000 chars plus 40-turn chat_log keep prompts bounded; story-buffer drains to vector memory every 25 turns to preserve history without state explosion.

nodes.label: GameState decision routing fields
nodes.rationale: Entry classifier writes DecisionReport plus legacy needs_* flags; react_router picks next_node with budget terminators (3 passes, 12 LLM calls, 60s) forcing to story for bounded latency/cost.
